meta.name: esm
meta.description: Use when working directly with the `esm` Python SDK, ESM3 or ESMC model IDs, Forge/Biohub inference clients, or ESMFold2 folding workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用ESM模型进行蛋白质序列分析与结构预测
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用ESM SDK做蛋白质折叠或序列研究
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein sequences and predict structures with ESM models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with ESM SDK for protein folding or sequence research

howto.what: Claude 可以帮你用 Python 调用 ESM 模型来生成蛋白质序列、预测结构、计算嵌入向量，以及进行功能注释和批量处理。
howto.when: 当你需要设计或分析蛋白质序列，或者使用 ESM3、ESMC、ESMFold2 等模型时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 ESM3 生成一段 200 个氨基酸的荧光蛋白序列。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的 Python 代码并解释步骤。

say.text: 用 ESMC 计算这个蛋白质序列的嵌入向量。
say.note: Claude 会展示如何加载模型并提取嵌入。

say.text: 从 PDB 文件做逆折叠，设计能折叠成该结构的序列。
say.note: Claude 会给出逆折叠的代码示例。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you use the ESM Python SDK to generate protein sequences, predict structures, compute embeddings, perform function annotation, and batch processing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design or analyze protein sequences, or use ESM3, ESMC, ESMFold2 models.

say_en.text: Help me generate a 200-residue fluorescent protein sequence using ESM3.
say_en.note: Claude will generate Python code and explain steps.

say_en.text: Compute embeddings for this protein sequence using ESMC.
say_en.note: Claude will show how to load the model and extract embeddings.

say_en.text: Do inverse folding from a PDB file to design a sequence that folds into that structure.
say_en.note: Claude will provide inverse folding code example.
